_meta.description: Category distribution plan and the exact per-entry JSON/JSONL schema used across active_ai_language_dataset.jsonl and active_ai_evaluation_set.jsonl. This file is a design artifact (not itself a training-data deliverable) produced as part of Phase 1 taxonomy design; the 7 required deliverables are produced in later tasks and will conform exactly to `entry_schema` below.
_meta.target_size: 20000+ (no artificial cap; expand further if category coverage gaps remain, per the user's explicit instruction)

category_distribution.note: Approximate share of the >=20,000 core dataset (active_ai_language_dataset.jsonl). Percentages are targets for generation balance, not a claim about real-world message frequency.

categories.description: Isolated real-estate/CRM terms across MSA/Egyptian/Franco/English (e.g. 'مقدم', 'down payment', 'تشطيب', 'view', 'مساحة').
2-5 word phrases: 'فيه فيو بحر؟', 'available units', 'كام قسط؟'.
Full sentences asking about price/availability/location/payment/delivery, no action requested.
'عايز شقة في التجمع تحت 3 مليون' style search/filter requests, mapped to search_units/search_projects intents.
Down payment, installment plans, cash discount, maintenance fee, currency questions and statements.
Bargaining, asking for discount, comparing offers, urgency-creation, closing language.
Price/location/timing/trust/competitor objections and hesitation language, spanning the enumerated objection intents.
Natural-language commands mapped to the 22 real system_action intents grounded in TOOL_REGISTRY, each fully annotated (intent/entities/params/risk/approval/confirmation).
Franco-Arabic/Arabizi renderings of entries from other categories (spelling-variant expansion of the same underlying utterances, not novel content).
Code-switched sentences typical of Egyptian real-estate sales chat.
Ultra-short, typo-prone, abbreviation-heavy real chat style ('متاح ؟', 'كام سعره', 'ok tmam').
Same-intent entries with realistic Arabic/English keyboard-switch typos and common misspellings layered on top.
2-6 turn dialogues carrying context across turns (hand-authored, task #261).
Underspecified requests that should trigger a clarifying question rather than an assumed action/entity (hand-authored, task #261).
ROI, rental yield, resale value, investor-focused questions.
B2B broker/agent commission, co-broke, deal-registration phrasing.
Internal team language: stage moves, follow-up scheduling, lead assignment discussed in natural language (distinct from the direct action-language category, this is descriptive/reporting phrasing).
Explicit synonym-cluster entries (same intent/entities, deliberately varied phrasing) used for paraphrase robustness.
Entries built around words whose meaning depends on context (حجز، استلام، السعر) with the disambiguating context included.

evaluation_set.size: 1000+ entries, held out, not sampled from the same generation batches as the core dataset
evaluation_set.composition_note: Skews toward adversarial/ambiguous/edge-case content relative to the core dataset's distribution, per spec Section 26.
required_slices: adversarial phrasing designed to look actionable but should NOT trigger an action (e.g. hypothetical/past-tense/third-party framing)
mixed-language sentences with embedded numbers/currency ambiguity
multi-turn context where the action-relevant entity was stated 2+ turns earlier
objections phrased as questions rather than statements
financially-significant action requests that must require confirmation/approval

entry_schema.description: Exact field set for every record in active_ai_language_dataset.jsonl and active_ai_evaluation_set.jsonl. active_ai_language_dataset.csv is a flattened export of the same fields (entities/context serialized as JSON strings in CSV cells).

text.description: The raw utterance/message exactly as a user would type or say it.

normalized_text.description: Canonicalized Arabic-script rendering of `text` (Franco/mixed converted to Arabic script) used as a normalization training signal.

franco_variant.description: If `text` itself is Franco-Arabic, this is null (text IS the variant); if `text` is Arabic/MSA and this record is paired with a Franco rendering elsewhere in the dataset, this holds that paired variant's id. Null when not applicable.

english_mix.description: The English-language substring(s) embedded in a mixed_ar_en entry, else null.

entities.description: Map of entity-type (from active_ai_entities.json `entity` keys) to extracted value(s). Empty object {} when none apply — never omitted.

context.description: For multi_turn_conversations: an array of prior {speaker, text} turns preceding this entry. Null for single-turn entries.

confidence.description: Honesty/provenance tag per spec Section 25 — never claims verified real-world usage unless it genuinely reflects an attested, commonly-seen pattern.

actionable.description: True only if `intent` is a system_action intent AND this specific utterance should trigger it (not merely mentions the topic).

action.description: Real actionType token from active_ai_intents.json when actionable=true, else null. Never fabricated — must exist in TOOL_REGISTRY.

permission_required.description: requiredPermission action:resource string when actionable=true, else null.

risk_level.description: Copied from the matched intent's risk_level when actionable, else null.

read_only.description: Copied from the matched intent when actionable, else null.
